notes: Fall 2026 Bioengineering Graduation Plan (Clark School resource_documents PDF). Gen Ed, ENGL101, Professional Writing, Oral Communication and free-elective slots are left out: only the major is audited.

BIOE Foundational I & II, BIOE Elective I-IV, Biological Science Elective II and the Breadth Elective are not encoded as Program requirements (no approved-course list in the source; see docs/project/owner-review.md), so those slots are also left out of this plan.

Biological Science Elective I (BSCI 2xx) is filled with BSCI222 (Principles of Genetics), a real 200-level BSCI course, to satisfy the encoded departments/number-range requirement. The department's term sheet lists this slot at 4 credits.
Chemistry lecture sequence taken as CHEM135 (the plan's own default); CHEM131 & CHEM134 is the encoded department-page alternative, not used here.
Cell Biology & Physiology taken as BSCI331 & BSCI332 (the plan's own default); BSCI330 is the encoded catalog alternative, not used here.
